case_title: MOHD ZAHID v. STATE THROUGH NCB
statutory_provisions: NDPS Act s.23, s.21; NDPS Act s.29 r/w s.21(c)
trial_court_outcome: Convicted and sentenced to 15 years RI
neutral_facts: The accused was involved in two separate transactions involving the trafficking of narcotics. In the first case, he was convicted for the recovery of 4 kg of heroin and sentenced to 12 years of rigorous imprisonment. In the second case, he was convicted for the recovery of 750 grams of heroin and sentenced to 15 years of rigorous imprisonment. The trial court did not specify whether the sentences should run concurrently or consecutively. The accused appealed, arguing that the sentences should run concurrently, but the court rejected this argument, stating that the two cases involved different transactions and different crime numbers, and therefore, the sentences could not be awarded concurrently under Section 427 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
